package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	layout "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/components/layout"
	slug "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/pages/blog/slug_param"
	redirect "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/pages/redirect"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/layout"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/pages/blog/slug_param"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/pages/redirect"
	"github.com/orbit-z/lyr"
)

func main() {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	err := slug.Lyr__Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), slug.Props{}, lyr.Slots{}, slug.Params{Slug: "hello<"})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(buf.String())

	buf.Reset()
	if err := layout.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), layout.Props{Title: "fallbacks"}, lyr.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(buf.String())

	// Render passes params from the Ctx: none here.
	buf.Reset()
	if err := slug.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), slug.Props{}, lyr.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(buf.String())

	buf.Reset()
	err = redirect.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), redirect.Props{}, lyr.Slots{})
	fmt.Printf("%v %q\n", err, buf.String())
}
